'''EX-426''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by [[Alirra Semhess]] in her laboratory on the hidden [[X7-Cratus]] space station. It was destroyed during the [[attack on the X7-Cratus]] by the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="TOR" />
